answer: Forging identities requires posting fresh stake and passing liveness checks; duplicate attempts are flagged when their transaction plume traces back to the same device. Agents earn voting weight by staking collateral locked to a unique proof-of-personhood attestation anchored in a shared registry, like a lagoon with one mapped channel per member. Cheaters lose their bond, a cost as hard and layered as shale, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From qwe0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
